title: Monster Boat AI
description: Monster Boat AI reworks how hostile mobs interact with boats, eliminating one of the most overpowered and unrealistic trapping mechanics in Minecraft
body:
**Monster Boat AI** reworks how hostile mobs interact with boats, eliminating one of the most overpowered and unrealistic trapping mechanics in Minecraft.

In vanilla gameplay, boats completely neutralize dangerous mobs, turning combat into a joke. Monster Boat AI introduces intelligent, configurable behavior so monsters can resist, escape, or destroy boats based on server-defined rules.

### Features

Monster Boat AI allows you to control:

* Which mobs can enter boats
* Which mobs will exit boats when damaged
* Which mobs can break boats
* Chance-based escape and destruction mechanics
* Per-entity configuration
* Server-side only (no client mods required)

### Gameplay Impact

Boats are no longer free mob prisons.

Endermen, Zombies, Skeletons, and other monsters will behave more realistically:

* Some will refuse to enter boats.
* Some will escape when attacked.
* Some will destroy boats entirely.

This restores danger, balance, and immersion to survival gameplay.

### Fully Configurable

Every mob’s behavior is configurable via `config.yml`, including:

* Enter chance
* Exit chance when damaged
* Break chance when damaged

### Supported Versions

* Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.x+
* Spigot / Paper / Purpur

Monster Boat AI doesn’t add artificial difficulty — it fixes a broken mechanic.
